name: @memberjunction/ng-bootstrap-lite
description: Lite class registrations manifest excluding lazy-loaded dashboard and settings packages

scripts.prebuild: if [ -d dist ]; then node ../../../packages/MJCLI/bin/run.js codegen manifest --appDir . --exclude-packages @memberjunction/ng-dashboards --exclude-packages @memberjunction/ng-explorer-settings --output ./src/generated/mj-class-registrations.ts --scan-dist || echo 'Warning: workspace CLI not built yet (build @memberjunction/cli first), using existing manifest'; else touch .needs-manifest-rebuild; fi
scripts.postbuild: if [ -f .needs-manifest-rebuild ]; then rm .needs-manifest-rebuild && (node ../../../packages/MJCLI/bin/run.js codegen manifest --appDir . --exclude-packages @memberjunction/ng-dashboards --exclude-packages @memberjunction/ng-explorer-settings --output ./src/generated/mj-class-registrations.ts --scan-dist && tsc && tsc-alias -f || echo 'Warning: workspace CLI not built yet (build @memberjunction/cli first), manifest will be generated on next build'); fi

author: MemberJunction
